sources: [S1] SAC (Standardization Administration of China) — ISO member #0156; no dedicated GB/T OEE standard found
[S1] ISO 22400-2:2014 — defines OEE mathematically; referenced in Chinese manufacturing literature
[S2] SAP Digital Manufacturing zh-CN — uses 设备综合效率 for OEE
[S2] Siemens Opcenter zh-CN — uses 设备综合效率, 可用率, 性能稼动率, 良品率
[S2] ABB MOM Production Intelligence zh-CN — confirms 设备综合效率
[S2] IBM China zh-CN — uses 设备综合效率, 可用率, 性能, 良品率
[S3] Microsoft Chinese Simplified Localization Style Guide — formal register for B2B software
[S4] Baidu Baike — 设备综合效率 article confirms OEE formula, JIPM origin, and established usage
[S4] Chinese manufacturing knowledge sources (华昊企管, 知乎, jiandaoyun.com) — confirm 设备综合效率 de facto usage

falseFriends.availability: 可用性 (kěyòng xìng) is the general concept; 可用率 (kěyòng lǜ) is more precise for the OEE metric ratio. SAP/Siemens/IBM use 可用率. Current 可用性 is widely understood but slightly generic. Flag for G3 review.
falseFriends.quality: 质量 (zhìliàng) is the general quality concept; 良品率 (liángpǐn lǜ) is the OEE quality rate metric (good units / total units). Siemens/IBM use 良品率 for OEE ratio specifically.
falseFriends.performance: 性能 (xìngnéng) is generic 'technical capabilities'. Siemens uses 性能稼动率 for OEE performance rate. Standalone 性能 is widely accepted in practice but technically imprecise.
falseFriends.changeover: Use 换产 (huàn chǎn, product changeover) not 换线 (huàn xiàn, change production line). 换线 implies infrastructure change; 换产 is SMED/setup concept.
falseFriends.stop: Use 停机 (tíngjī, machine stop event) not 停止 (tíngzhǐ, generic cease/stop verb). 停机 specifically implies equipment downtime.
falseFriends.scrap: Use 废品 (fèipǐn, defective product) not 废料 (fèiliào, raw material waste/offcuts). OEE quality scrap = rejected product units (废品), not material waste (废料).
falseFriends.setup: Use 换产时间 (changeover time) or 准备时间 (preparation time) for manufacturing setup. 设置时间 carries IT/software configuration connotation. Flag for G3 review.

grammarNotes.measureWords: Chinese requires measure words between numbers and nouns: '一台设备' (one unit of equipment, 台=machine classifier), '三个班次' (three shifts, 个=general), '五批产品' (five batches, 批=batch). In dashboard labels, classifiers are omitted ('3 班次').
grammarNotes.wordOrder: Modifiers precede nouns: '设备综合效率' (equipment overall effectiveness), '停机原因' (machine-stop reason), '理想循环时间' (ideal cycle time). Translators must restructure English modifier-head order.
grammarNotes.noInflection: No verb conjugation, pluralization, or gender. '停机' = both singular 'stop' and plural 'stops'. One Chinese string covers both — not a duplication error.
grammarNotes.simplifiedCharacters: Use Simplified Chinese characters exclusively. Traditional (台灣/香港) is not interchangeable. Any translation containing Traditional characters must be corrected.
grammarNotes.displayWidth: Each Chinese character occupies ~2 display columns in fixed-width contexts. A 5-character string (技术可用性) ≈ 10 Latin characters in display width. Length multiplier accounts for this.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: Not applicable — Chinese has no morphological pluralization. Singular and plural forms are identical.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: 设备综合效率 is the de facto standard Chinese OEE term, confirmed by SAP, Siemens, ABB, IBM. OEE (English acronym) is used as dashboard header; 设备综合效率 as expanded label. No Chinese OEE abbreviation (e.g., SZX) has emerged. Practitioner preference: mixed — both OEE and 设备综合效率 used together.
standardsUsed: ISO 22400-2 (referenced, not formally adopted as GB/T)
industryContext.dominantVendors: SAP (large enterprise), Siemens Opcenter (automotive/discrete), ABB MOM (process), Kingdee/金蝶 (domestic ERP), Inspur/浪潮 (domestic MES). China MES market USD 2.68B in 2024, 12.2% CAGR.
industryContext.smartManufacturing: Made in China 2025 promotes 智能制造 (intelligent manufacturing). Key terms: 工业互联网 (Industrial Internet/IIoT), 数字化转型 (digital transformation), 精益生产 (lean production), 制造执行系统/MES.
industryContext.japaneseOrigin: 设备综合效率 parallels Japanese 設備総合効率 — TPM/OEE methodology came to China through Japanese manufacturing investment (Toyota, Honda, Panasonic factories since 1980s-1990s).

commonMistakes: Using 废料原因 instead of 废品原因 for 'scrap reason' — 废料 is raw material waste; 废品 is defective finished product. OEE quality scrap = 废品.
Using 停止 (generic stop verb) instead of 停机 (manufacturing machine stop event) — 停机 is the OEE-relevant term.
Using Traditional Chinese characters from zh-TW sources instead of Simplified — always validate character set for zh locale.
Translating 'shift' as 班 (work team/group) instead of 班次 (work shift time period) — Evocon tracks shift periods, not team assignments.
Using 效率 alone as shorthand for OEE — ambiguous; use full 设备综合效率 or English OEE acronym.
Using software-context 设置 for manufacturing 'setup' — 设置时间 sounds like configuring software; 换产时间 or 准备时间 is more manufacturing-specific.
notes: 设备综合效率 is the de facto standard Chinese OEE term, confirmed by 4 S2 vendor sources (SAP, Siemens, ABB, IBM). Both Chinese term and OEE acronym are used together — OEE as header, 设备综合效率 as label. Simplified Chinese characters only (Mainland China). Formal 您 in professional software UI. Display width: each character ≈ 2 Latin columns. Empirical P95 (display-adjusted) = 1.06; multiplier 1.5 provides 42% headroom.
